Prune keeps 6 hourly + 3 daily DB snapshots on /fast, hourly cron (Chad 10-20: 24 hourlies pinned 62 GB, /fast 90%)
Failed service probes report why (timeout/DNS/TLS/refused) — the 10-20 18:00 'Public API (tunnel): status 0' alert could not be traced
Review popup on the solid surface (surface-1 is 80% alpha — the chat showed through the document)
RTF/Word/WordPerfect/ODT/EPUB originals readable in the Review popup (server-converted, sanitised, sandboxed) + 'View it' on offer cards — read before Add it / Not this one (Chad 10-20)
Read roots include Public/Ocean-books and Public/pilgrim-notes (Chad's 10-20 sweeps were refused 400 'outside the folders Dewey may read'); test pin SEARCH_VERSION 2026-10-20.4
Migration 161 unreachable (CURRENT_VERSION not bumped) → every holdings check 500'd 'no such table: dewey_checks'; the memo read is now an optimisation — a failure is a miss, never a failed check

Holdings-check memo — file content sha256 → last verdict (dewey_checks, migr 161); the same book checked again (renamed, moved) answers instantly; held stands while its document is live, other verdicts 7 days; ?fresh=1 (Chad 10-20)

MEILI_WRITES=off — stop pushing paragraphs/HyPE/mentions/aliases to Meilisearch (retirement step 5); it was the largest I/O on /fast (20 MB/s r, 13 MB/s w) though search reads only Qdrant, while writes took 9–27 s and hydration 2–6 s. Dirty rows settled; removals still reach Qdrant

Stamp-voices/stamp-site yield to a drain and resume where they stopped — #973 held the indexer in 'draining' for hours; a yielding job's resume params are saved on the run (saveResume) so the requeue continues, not restarts

Two 30 s main-thread reads behind 10-20 gateway timeouts — library slug fallback read every docs row (now matching collections only, via docs-repo.docsForPathSlugs); planExhaustion prose check GROUP BY over ~600 books' paragraphs → EXISTS per book

Settled plan books are not re-probed — refill (every 3 min) and planExhaustion walked all ~600 finished books on the API main thread each time (5–8 s resume-stage spikes); null answers remembered 30 min, each probe yields the loop
The grounding exhaustion probe gets 30 s (it checks every plan book, 5–6 s) — the default 8 s timeout made an exhausted plan a CRITICAL 'nothing queued' alarm
Rights classes per Chad's rule — Writings, institutional and anything online are shareable in full; only privately published books not found online are restricted

Rights — the old encumbered flag is overly broad (collection/religion defaults); restrict only on per-document evidence, unknown stays shareable and goes to review; measure current breadth first (Chad 10-20)
Rights replaces the encumbered flag — per-document class + evidence, one servingPolicy module; encumbered derived then retired (Chad 10-20)
Rights classification — shareable in full vs copyrighted (encumbered) for every document; Dewey sets it at intake, backfill for the library (Chad 10-20)
Keep only the newest 3 daily DB snapshots on /fast (Chad 10-20) — 31 dailies pinned ~60 GB of churned DB blocks and the pool hit 96%; full daily copies live on /tank
Coverage one pass
Book coverage (prose/disamb/hyped/extracted/hypeable) is ONE pass over the book's rows, not five COUNT subqueries — grounding:resume-stage took 8.8 s on the API main thread for large books
Site DBs — the per-site store already exists for site-only (getSiteDb); step 2 extends it

Stamp-site job — every scraped site's Qdrant points carry `site` (payload only, by doc-id batches, keyword index) so site scopes filter in Qdrant and hits can hydrate from per-site stores (planning/site-databases-plan.md step 1)
One database per scraped site (bahai-library, oceanoflights, bahaiteachings); OceanLibrary.com stays in the primary DB as the canonical English collection (Chad 10-20)
With no --qdrant flag the type battery uses the server's default search config — it sent qdrant:false and silently measured the legacy Meili path

Spending Chad approved is not an alarm — the 24 h spend alert fires only above the base threshold plus the active approved allowances (data/approved-spend.json: doctrinal index 00/day, authorship 0/day, until 10-27)
The authoritative pass runs only in a Bahá'í-scoped search again — unscoped it displaced other traditions (battery 66 → 60: karma, wu wei, nirvana, fasting). SEARCH_VERSION bumped

Under SEARCH_QDRANT=only hybridSearch / keywordSearch / searchHypeQuestions answer from Qdrant (authority-ranked multiIndexSearch with Meili off; BM25 for keyword mode) — every direct Meili caller (public /v1/search, keyword route, chat, deep research, grounding counts) moves at once; site-only scopes stay on Meili for now (Chad 10-20: retire Meilisearch)
Meili retirement — direct search callers inventoried; documents/deep_research write-only

The authoritative pass also runs in UNSCOPED searches (most readers never pick a tradition — 'detachment from the world' found no Hidden Words) as candidates; the Bahá'í tier weights still apply only in a Bahá'í search, so interfaith slots stay fair. SEARCH_VERSION bumped

Qdrant ranks alone (SEARCH_QDRANT=only) — with doctrinal-authority fusion the type battery scores 66/83 vs 63/83 on Meili, p50 1.6 s vs 4.4 s, p95 4.2 s vs 18 s (Chad 10-20: retire Meilisearch). Meili still receives writes; rollback = phrase,keyword
Person-search claims (bioSearch hay_folded LIKE scan, 5.8 s) run on the claim-search worker thread's own connection — no longer on the API's event loop

Each writer cycle leaves a phase breadcrumb (/tmp/siftersearch-writer-phase.json) and the watchdog logs it when it restarts the writer — a 45 s freeze at 07:08 left no trace (killed before any slow-query log); the watchdog never restarts twice within 2 min (the old writer is still draining)

Bahá'í doctrinal tiers and the authoritative pass apply only inside a Bahá'í-scoped search — unscoped interfaith queries ('what is nirvana', Qur'anic patience, karma) were handed Bahá'í texts first; across traditions each passage ranks by its own authority within its tradition's slots. SEARCH_VERSION bumped
Bump SEARCH_VERSION — doctrinal-authority ranking invalidates cached results

The authoritative pass filters on the indexed author_fold only (a should over the unindexed voices_fold scanned 35M points — it timed out on every query) and also searches the doctrinal HyPE questions; voices_fold payload indexes created on phrases/hype/paragraphs_kw

The 'answers the question' band is measured within each tradition — interfaith results give each tradition its own slots, so a Bahá'í passage is judged against the best Bahá'í passage (a secondary book had taken the Bahá'í slot from Bahá'u'lláh's Tablets)

Authenticated text first — a central figure's words count in full only in an authoritative book (own works, compilations of the Writings, the House's); quoted or recalled in a secondary book their doctrinal factor is capped at 1.3, so the original outranks the account ('Visiting the Bahá'í World Centre' outranked the Íqán). Hits carry book_authority

A question is not a quotation — the verbatim lead no longer promotes a passage that merely restates the question ('what is the purpose of prayer' led with a PDF over 'Abdu'l-Bahá's answer), and only an authoritative copy (doctrinal factor ≥ 1) leads a quotation

DOCTRINAL AUTHORITY throughout ranking (Chad 10-20: authority from the outset; dedup favours canonical; re-rank favours the authoritative passage that answers) — Qdrant layers carry the writer (author_fold/scope/collection) and fusion weighs each contribution by it (Revelation ×3 > interpretation ×2.6 > the House ×1.6 > others; pilgrim notes ×0.4; scraped-site copies ×0.7); an authoritative pass retrieves the doctrinal writers' passages so they are always candidates; duplicate passages collapse to their most authoritative copy; final re-rank multiplies by the PARAGRAPH writer's factor within the answer band (≥½ the top score). Was: ×1.2 post-hoc blend on the book's author, skipped for some query shapes

Pre-deploy test boots run the production boot order (API_PREBOOT=1) under a 50 s deadline below pm2's 60 s listen_timeout — the fork-mode test listened first and passed in 5 s while the real preboot hung (10-20 search outage)

The concept lexicon load blocked the API's event loop for minutes at boot (proofParagraph re-parsed/re-folded every row per entry) — the new search instance never listened and pm2 stopped the old one after listen_timeout. Rows indexed once (map lookup), yields every 200 entries; no lexicon warm-up at boot
Meilisearch retirement plan — inventory of indexes and callers; Qdrant-only battery loses famous passages to secondary copies (no authority fusion) → authority-aware fusion first

Concept and entity layers read SQLite, not Meilisearch (Chad 10-20: retire Meilisearch) — the cited lexicon held in memory (warmed at boot, 30 min refresh), entity mentions by entity_id via entity-mentions-repo ranked by the paragraph author's authority
